purpose: Freeze how multisource regulatory programs may become candidates for privileged teacher-state construction without outcome-driven cherry-picking.

required: program namespace status is FROZEN_STRUCTURAL or QUALIFIED_PROGRAM
program membership is immutable and SHA-bound
Stage-4 result, if used, is interpretable under its own authority
at least one additional evidence family with a different dominant failure mode is available
no protected outcome was used to define or prune membership
missingness and source disagreement remain explicit
eligibility.note: The default is a governance rule to prevent Stage-4-alone promotion. It is not a biological effect-size threshold and must be red-teamed before real selection.

stage4_role.positive: counts as PRIMARY_CORRESPONDENCE evidence only; cannot independently qualify a teacher program
stage4_role.interpretable_null: cannot support positive teacher-program promotion but may contribute null/uncertainty evidence
stage4_role.uninterpretable: blocks Stage-4 as positive evidence for that program

source_rules.scenic_plus: May define the frozen external regulatory architecture only after provenance/leakage/control qualification. It is not itself confirmation of biology in the construction cohort.
source_rules.morabito: May contribute separate-nucleus replication only after protected replication authorization.
source_rules.seaad_multiome: May contribute same-nucleus support but is not pristine cohort replication because SEA-AD contributed to FULL104.
source_rules.perturbation: May contribute causal support only where target engagement, independent units and outcome-exposure rules qualify.
source_rules.spatial: May contribute intact-tissue support only where panel coverage is sufficient.

forbidden: promoting a program because it has the largest Stage-4 Delta
dropping programs because Morabito disagrees after results are opened without predeclared rule
choosing between Route A and Route B based on protected validation agreement
combining p-values/effect sizes across incomparable sources into an ad-hoc score
using FULL104 predicted transport as independent biological validation
treating source absence as negative biological evidence
